newsitem.title: USA: Argosy Gaming Q1 EBITDA rises.
newsitem.headline: Argosy Gaming Q1 EBITDA rises.

text.p: Argosy Gaming Co said Wednesday its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) rose to $11.6 million in the first quarter, up from $10.9 million a year ago.
First-quarter 1997 EBITDA excluded a $1.8 million severance charge, while the year-ago EBITDA was before pre-opening costs and one-time charges. Earlier, Argosy reported a net loss for
the quarter of $9.0 million or $0.37 a share after the severance charge. A year ago, its net loss was $1.0 million or $0.04 a share after $1.9 million in development and pre-opening costs.
The company said it did not record any tax benefit in the current year, compared with an $867,000 benefit in the 1996 quarter.
Net revenues in the quarter rose to $82.5 million from $62.7 million, while total expenses increased to $80.5 million from $60.8 million.

Revenues were helped by the opening of a phase one temporary casino in Lawrenceburg, Ind. However, revenues decreased at Alton, Ill., and Riverside, Mo., due to new competition and substantially increased capacity in these markets.
